info.title: D7 Networks Universal API
info.description: D7 Networks provides APIs for SMS, OTP verification, WhatsApp, Viber, and number lookup messaging workflows.

get.description: Retrieves number lookup status from D7 Networks.

parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.
